data.situation: Allianz payment fails (FPX simulator status not 00), then is cancelled (SPayLater), then the customer pays by FPX: messages on the payment page, CIBO status, final purchase
data.setup:
• When: after Dev deploys EAINT-12406 to Secarang staging /ia/ and CIBO staging (not deployed yet on 28.10.2026, Azfar)
• Secarang staging /ia/ (https://staging.secarang.com/ia/car-insurance), desktop browser, no user login. First the site password page (password from the QA team, not written here; the same on /ia/ and /preprod/). The password page can come back on the Fiuu popup and on the Success page: enter the site password again there. The Fiuu Bank Simulator has its own username + password: never type the site password there (doc §2, §13). Stay on /ia/: a visitor form on /ia/ can open a /preprod/ page in a new tab (seen in the code, walk 28.10); do not continue on /preprod/
• CIBO staging https://staging.secarang.com/cibo (login page /cibo/auth/login; /ia/cibo is NOT CIBO), the QA team's admin login; it shares the back end with Secarang /ia/, so it records the /ia/ purchases (walk 28.10). Insurance Company filters (Transaction Management, Payment Report, Commission Report) are grouped by agency: Bintang Prospek (Chubb, RHB, Takaful Malaysia), Pemaju Eksklusif (Lonpac, TokioMarine, Zurich Takaful), Serba Sentral (Allianz, eTiqa); ticking a group header ticks all its insurers, so tick the insurer itself. There is no agency filter, and Payment Management has no insurer filter. Transaction Management shows no rows until [Search]; on other listings wait for the first load before [Search] (doc §10). Export narrow date ranges only
• Owner (Private tab): on the simulator any IC will do (Azfar 28.10); the QA team's /ia/ IC, postcode 55000, is a safe choice. /ia/ is on the simulator now, so made-up plates quote. With Allianz's real UAT API (a SIT pass Azfar may add) the vehicle and owner IC must be real: Allianz checks the IC for a quotation (Azfar 28.10). Phone on Confirmation: type it without the leading 0 (the field keeps +60). Never the QA's own name, IC, phone or address in evidence names
• Vehicle: an individual-owner renewal car that Allianz quotes (not used by another row)
• Payment: FPX Online banking > RHB Bank > Bank Simulator Status other than 00 (e.g. 51) for the failure; SPayLater > [Cancel the transaction] > 'Are you sure?' > [OK] for the cancel (only [OK] cancels; before it the main window looks the same); then FPX Approved (00). Do not use 3D Secure [CANCEL] (it leaves the transaction Pending) (team doc §5)
data.steps:
1. Secarang: Allianz quotation > Add-ons > Confirmation > Confirm and Pay
2. FPX Online banking > RHB Bank > Bank Simulator Status 51 > [Pay now]; screenshot the payment page
3. Still on the payment page: SPayLater > [Cancel the transaction] > [OK]; screenshot the main window after [OK]
4. FPX Online banking > RHB Bank > Status Approved (00) > TAC > [Pay now]; screenshot the Success page
5. After the final payment: CIBO > Payment Management: find the transaction's row and its Payment Status; screenshot. CIBO > Transaction Management: search the plate; screenshot the one row and its final status (recorded)
Do not try to reopen or continue a pending payment: on Secarang a pending payment cannot be continued and nothing is resubmitted (Azfar 29.10)
data.expected:
Ensure:
• After the failed FPX payment: back on the payment page with "Unsuccessful payment You may try again.", no receipt, and the other payment tiles can still be picked
• CIBO Payment Management and Transaction Management each show one row for the transaction, final status Paid / Insurance created; the failed FPX attempt is not listed separately (recorded)
• After cancelling SPayLater with [OK]: back on 'How would you like to pay?' with the same vehicle and premium
• The final FPX payment completes: Success page with a [Receipt] download, and CIBO shows the transaction with Payment Paid, Ins. Co. Allianz

After cancelling SPayLater with [OK]: back on 'How would you like to pay?' with the same vehicle and premium
The final FPX payment completes: Success page with a [Receipt] download, and CIBO shows the transaction with Payment Paid, Ins. Co. Allianz

data.source: E2 recorded (decided 29.10 under Azfar's full permission, main session, v6b): Payment Management and Transaction Management keep one row per transaction with its final status (seen 29.10, BR60006353); a 'Failed' row exists only when the last payment failed (BR60006327). The team doc §5 'shows in CIBO (Paid / Failed)' refers to that final status. Observed / current behaviour (the Allianz flow is unchanged, SRD v1.1 §2.2.2 #2b): failed and cancelled handling from SRD EAINT-12107 REQ-007 / REQ-008, live 20.10.2026 (team doc §3, §5); CIBO 'Failed' record (doc §5) and no buttons unless Insurance created (mockup CIBO 20261006 row BR55009007). Final purchase: SRD v1.1 REQ-002 Example 1b

data.steps:
1. Secarang: the car + owner > All Quotations > Allianz > Add-ons (wait for the page to load); screenshot every add-on with its price and More Info (recorded)
2. For each add-on that has options (e.g. CART period / daily compensation, Road Warrior plan, PA plan): change the option once and note the premium; screenshot each (recorded). Windscreen Sum Insured: type a value below its range, then above it, then inside it (range RM500–RM1,820 on 29.10); record what is accepted; APPLY the inside value, so the all-add-ons purchase carries it
3. Try to remove each add-on that looks mandatory (e.g. Road Rangers); screenshot (recorded)
4. Tick EVERY add-on; note the premium; Continue > Confirmation (owner details) > screenshot the add-ons and the total > Confirm and Pay
5. FPX Online banking > RHB Bank > Status Approved (00) > TAC > [Pay now]; screenshot the Success page; download the [Receipt]
